serving_option: User-provided local OpenAI-compatible endpoint, for example vLLM
selection_rationale: Small, openly available text model with documented local serving interface; candidate to compare before and after retrieval-conditioned behavior tuning. No task-specific quality or throughput claim.
financial_model: Measure GPU-hour cost, throughput, and latency on the selected hardware, or supply per-token API rates to the harness. A GPU size or rate is not inferred from parameter count.
context_budget_definition: Proposed total input-plus-output token target; not automatically enforced by the harness.
